title: RunRecord
$comment: Machine-readable copy of the RunRecord dataclass in src/macro_pipeline/observability.py (B8 — the PRD §339 audit row / one JSONL line per briefing in logs/runs.jsonl). Keep in lockstep with that dataclass and RunRecord.to_json().

input_hash.$comment: sha256 hex of the canonical (sort_keys) BriefingRequest; empty on an error_record (no request to hash)

model.$comment: production model id; null on fallback

validator_failed.$comment: failed O-check ids only, e.g. ["O5","O8"]; [] when none

llm_calls.$comment: best-effort quota-accounting count: produce_briefing invocations this run (≈1), not the exact provider HTTP-call count (retry/failover can be higher)

error.$comment: short error string when the run errored, else null

output.$comment: §339 rendered briefing: validated dict (llm) | fallback/refusal card text | null when skipped/errored

sources.$comment: Per-external-source health for this run, keyed by source name (fred | treasury | gold_api | ...). Populated by observability.record_source() at each swallow point — without it a degraded vendor leaves no trace at all.

degraded.$comment: sticky: true when we did not get the good data (exception, empty tip, missing history)

error.$comment: first error string this run, truncated to 140 chars

indicators_blanked.$comment: display-tier indicator ids dropped to null by the plausibility guard (pipeline.py); [] when none

stale_indicators.$comment: ids past their own stale_after_days, ANY tier — wider than any_stale (core-only, UI banner). The alerting predicate as of 2026-08-14: a transient source failure no longer pages, so a vendor outage must surface as its rows aging out. Not in `required`: rows written before 2026-08-14 do not carry it.

releases_last_24h.$comment: the releases the LLM was shown. The row stores only the input HASH, so a later rebuild cannot recover these — and C4 (whats_new fires IFF a release did) is unjudgeable without them.

rejected_outputs.$comment: The LLM drafts the validator REJECTED on a fallback run, in attempt order (invalid only; a refusal is a correct output). `output` is what the reader saw; this is what the model said and lost. Added 2026-09 after two fallbacks (08-25, 09-02) had to be diagnosed by reproducing the failure signature. Not in `required`: rows written before it do not carry it.

llm_usage.$comment: One entry per Claude call this run (retries and failover included), from response.usage. Added with ADR-007 (Claude on Bedrock) for cost accounting. Not in `required`: Gemini-era rows do not carry it.
